note: The melee strike also hits two other nearby enemies at once, with one critical roll; at less damage at the first level, none less at the last.

def.name: Echoing Blow
def.description: The strike lands on other enemies near it as well.

note: The supported bow or wand attack fires three more projectiles, one after another, so all of them can hit the same enemy; each hits for about two thirds less and every projectile makes the attack take 5% longer.

def.name: Rolling Volleys
def.description: Three more projectiles, fired one after another so that they can all hit one enemy; each hits much less, and the attack takes longer.

note: Hits can blind enemies (10% chance): a blinded enemy misses half of its attacks. A blind is not a curse.

def.name: Dazzle
def.description: Hits can blind enemies, so that they miss half of their attacks.

note: Enemies block less against the supported skill, and a blocked hit leaves the blocker Overpowered, a further 5% less able to block for four seconds, stacking.

def.name: Guard Breaker
def.description: Enemies block less against your hits, and every block you meet makes the next likelier to fail.

note: Hits can make normal monsters flee (and magic ones half the time); rare monsters do not flee.

def.name: Rout
def.description: Hits can make enemies lose their nerve and run.

note: A share of the damage dealt is leeched as energy shield; more damage while on full energy shield and while leeching it.

def.name: Ward Siphon
def.description: Damage dealt returns as energy shield, and you hit harder while it does.

note: Raises the quality of the supported gem (modelled as a small increase in damage).

def.name: Refine Gem
def.description: Raises the quality of the supported gem.

note: Lowers the mana cost multiplier of the supported gem group (modelled as a cost multiplier below one).

def.name: Deep Insight
def.description: Makes the supported skill cheaper to cast.

note: Spells deal added fire damage against burning enemies only; it has no ignite chance of its own.

def.name: Cindering
def.description: Adds fire damage to the spell against enemies that burn.

note: Ignites spread to the enemies near the one that burns, while it burns and as it dies, and ignite damage rises.

def.name: Wildfire Seed
def.description: Ignites spread to the enemies near a burning one.

note: A cheaper skill; each time the supported skills spend mana they give an Insight charge (more elemental damage and critical chance for each held); the charges are all lost when the supported skills have spent a limit in mana.

def.name: Lightheart
def.description: A cheaper skill that earns Insight each time it is used, and loses it when much mana has gone.

note: Each cast builds an Intensity (four at most): each gives more area damage and less area; the skill has more area besides. One stack is lost for every quarter second spent moving.

def.name: Swelling Blast
def.description: Area spells swell with each cast, while you stand and cast.

note: More rarity of the items dropped by enemies killed while the supported skill is socketed.

def.name: Scavenger
def.description: Enemies drop rarer items.

note: Skills with a duration: the effects they make (ground, clouds, buffs) end sooner, and the skill deals more damage. Ailments and the time traps and mines wait are not changed.

def.name: Brief Burst
def.description: The skill's effects end sooner and hit harder.

note: Skills with a duration: the effects they make last longer, with no cost to damage.

def.name: Lingering Effect
def.description: The skill's effects last longer.

note: Hits maim (30% chance, four seconds): a maimed enemy moves more slowly and takes more physical damage; the skill deals more physical damage.

def.name: Hamstring
def.description: Hits can maim: a maimed enemy moves slowly and takes more physical damage.

note: Bow attacks only: a hit with an arrow calls a mirage archer (one at a time, four seconds) that uses the same skill at less damage and a much slower rate.

def.name: Twin Shadow
def.description: A shadow of you fires along with you for a while after a hit.

note: Daggers and claws only: a critical strike makes the character Elusive (it cannot be renewed until it ends); while Elusive the skill has a little more critical chance and a great deal more critical multiplier.

def.name: Veil Cut
def.description: Critical strikes make you elusive, and elusive you crit harder.

note: Melee hits grant Rage, which boosts attacks.

def.name: Fury Well
def.description: Melee hits build Rage.

note: Maces, sceptres and staves only: a melee hit sets off a shockwave around the enemy hit, of 160% of the base attack damage whatever the hit was; one a second.

def.name: Shattering Blows
def.description: Blunt hits send a shockwave through the enemies around.

note: The spell also lands on the ground before and behind its target, with less area and less damage.

def.name: Flanking Cast
def.description: The spell lands before and behind its target as well.

note: The spell gains a Seal every so often while it is not cast (three at most); the next cast spends them all as repeats in quick succession, each at less damage.

def.name: Double Release
def.description: The spell is released again for each seal it gained while resting.

note: The supported curse is cast as an aura around the character and works on every enemy within it (more area at higher levels), reserving mana; it counts against the curse limit.

def.name: Standing Curse
def.description: The supported curse stands around you on every enemy in reach, at the cost of reserved mana.

note: Spells linked to the supported melee skill are cast when it kills.

def.name: Slayer's Echo
def.description: Linked spells are cast when your melee blows kill.

note: Spells linked to the supported spell are cast when the character has taken a heavy blow (a stun is approximated by a large hit).

def.name: Reeling Cast
def.description: Linked spells are cast when a heavy blow lands on you.
